instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor training room with black mats. On the right, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) stands firmly while lifting his partner. On the left, the man in the white and blue t-shirt (R2) is lifted off the ground, his legs wrapped around R1's hip. R1 holds R2 securely around the waist and thighs as R2 clings to R1's upper body. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene with neutral colors.
